title: Channel Preview Mechanism
description: Implement per-channel preview mechanism across flow and procedural so geometry components display all input/output channels on hover/select, plus robust offset on circle profiles.
summary: Implemented per-channel preview across flow and procedural: neural evaluator returns resolved inputs; flow eval emits channel JSON; DAG hovered/selected channel refs; procedural preview registry with port/direction items and visibility rules; play/playground channel wiring; offsetSync offsets circle/rectangle profiles analytically with tessellatable drawing results.
